subject: Allocation routing for consolidated invoice — Horizon Retail
messages:
From: AP Team <ap@horizonretail.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice 5621 — allocation to multiple Horizon entities

Hi Mateo,

Attached is Invoice 5621 and our PO for the quarter (PO_1432.pdf). Horizon needs the invoice to reflect allocation across our legal entities: Horizon US, Horizon EMEA, and Horizon Retail Services. Finance requires either separate invoices per legal entity or a single consolidated invoice that clearly marks line-level entity assignments and VAT treatment so our AP system can route payments to the right cost centers.

Can Redwood confirm which invoice formats you can support and whether you can include our cost center codes on the invoice lines (Retail Ops: CC-3002, Platform: CC-1410, Security: CC-7701)? Also, please indicate the tax/VAT handling for the EMEA portion — we may need a VAT reverse-charge note or a separate invoice from Redwood EMEA.

We prefer payment to go to a single vendor account if possible, but will accept multiple invoices if required.

Thanks,
Luke Carver
Horizon Retail — Accounts Payable
ap@horizonretail.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Invoice_5621.pdf, PO_1432.pdf

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Apr 2026 12:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice 5621 — allocation to multiple Horizon entities

Hi Luke — thanks for the details and the PO. Looping in Marissa (Finance Ops) and Karthik (Revenue Ops) to confirm routing.

Short answers up front:
- We can produce a single consolidated PDF invoice that includes line-level entity tags and cost-center codes (we'll include the CC codes you provided).
- For legal/tax purposes, we will also need to produce accounting backing (allocation schedule) that separates out which portion maps to Redwood US LLC vs Redwood EMEA Ltd. That schedule can be attached to the invoice as a separate page or as an Excel workbook.
- VAT: if Horizon EMEA requires reverse-charge treatment, we will mark the EMEA lines accordingly, but we may also need your VAT ID and confirmation for reverse-charge. If Horizon prefers separate invoices originating from our EU legal entity, we can do that as well — tradeoff is multiple invoices vs. single-invoice convenience.

I've attached a draft allocation workbook (2026_Q1_alloc.xlsx) with a suggested split across the three cost centers and the two Redwood legal entities. Quick summary (numbers are illustrative until we lock the PO mapping):
- Retail Ops (CC-3002): $42,150 — Redwood US LLC (Tax ID: XX-XXXXXXX)
- Platform (CC-1410): $21,400 — Redwood US LLC
- Security (CC-7701): $8,450 — Redwood EMEA Ltd (VAT treatment may apply)

Requests from our side:
1) Confirm Horizon's VAT ID for EMEA and whether you will accept reverse-charge notes.
2) Confirm whether AP prefers a single invoice with line-level tags or multiple invoices by legal entity.
3) Confirm final PO numbers to appear on the invoice lines (I see PO_1432 attached; if there are additional PO refs for the different cost centers please send them).

If you'd like, we can set a short call to run through the allocation table — we find a 20-minute screen-share helps avoid back-and-forth.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 09 Apr 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice 5621 — allocation to multiple Horizon entities

Thanks Mateo — quick clarifications: we confirm PO_1432 is the master PO. For internal reasons our AP system prefers a single invoice with line-level entity/cost-center fields (it can import line tags). Multiple invoices are allowed but create reconciliation overhead.

We can provide the VAT ID for Horizon EMEA (EU-VAT-7845123) — yes to reverse-charge where applicable.

Two asks:
- Can you embed the cost-center code and a field like "EntityCode" on each invoice line (our import mapping will use those to auto-route)?
- If you do a single invoice, will Redwood provide a summary allocation PDF (signed by Redwood finance) that our auditors can use?

Happy to do a 20-minute call Friday morning if that helps.

Best,
Luke
AP Team — Horizon Retail

Attachment: PO_1432.pdf

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Luke Carver <luke.carver@horizonretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice 5621 — allocation and delivery plan

Luke / Team — thanks for confirming. Proposed plan below (we think this satisfies Horizon's AP and audit needs while minimizing manual reconciliation):

1) Invoice format
- Redwood will issue a single consolidated invoice PDF (Invoice_5621_consolidated.pdf) with line-level fields: Description, Quantity, Unit Price, Extended, CostCenter (e.g., CC-3002), EntityCode (US or EMEA), and VATNote
- The consolidated PDF will be accompanied by an allocation workbook (Excel) that shows the per-line breakdown and totals per legal entity.

2) VAT / Tax handling
- For EMEA lines where you indicated reverse-charge applies we will include a VAT reverse-charge statement and reference your VAT ID (EU-VAT-7845123). Redwood EMEA Ltd will be listed as the supplying entity for those lines in the allocation workbook and in the internal tax records.

3) Payment routing and ledger impact
- Payments can be remitted to a single Redwood bank account (details below). Redwood will internally allocate receipts to Redwood US LLC and Redwood EMEA Ltd per the signed allocation workbook. We will provide a signed Mutual Allocation Plan (MAP) as supporting documentation for your auditors. That MAP is attached as signed-MAP.pdf.

Bank (example): Redwood Corporate Banking
Account: 12345678
Routing: 11000022
Please confirm whether Horizon requires vendor-bank details to be split on the invoice or if a single set of bank details is acceptable.

4) Next steps / approvals
- Marissa will finalize the allocation workbook and produce the consolidated invoice.
- We will prepare the signed allocation summary for your records and, if required, produce separate invoice stubs per legal entity as an optional deliverable.
- If Horizon agrees, we'll finalize and send the consolidated invoice by EOD Wed 2026-04-14.

If that plan works I will mark this as approved internally and Marissa will send the final invoice. Otherwise please reply with any changes.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
